value.message: In this step, you will import an update set into your prod instance. An update set is a collection of configuration changes, customizations, and scripts that have been recorded from a previous sub-prod instance.This step is crucial for ensuring that all necessary modifications are applied to the new sub-prod instance.

This update set includes the choices you made during the pre-upgrade tasks in the lower environment.When you commit it, your application configuration is automatically carried forward and used during production upgrade.
The upgrade will install/upgrade the applications to the requested versions. Review your plan.
